watch.name: Atmos Rewards
watch.what: Combined Alaska and Hawaiian airline loyalty program with its own premium co-brand cards.
watch.why_fit: A major West Coast airline currency that issuers are actively paying to acquire members for, relevant to any airline benefit or transfer play.

history.note: Bank of America targeted offers rose to 125k points on the Atmos Summit and 90k on the Atmos Ascent. Atmos also has a double points promo on Hawaii flights through March 10, 2027.

items.title: PayRewards: Pay business bills by credit card, earn transferable points (Atmos Rewards coming soon!)
items.why: A bill-pay fintech turning card spend into transferable points is a candidate for partner outreach.
items.summary_ai: PayRewards lets users pay business bills by card for a 2.9% fee and earn transferable points, with Atmos Rewards support coming.
items.take: A bill-pay fintech turning card spend into transferable points is a candidate for partner outreach.
items.low_confidence: Atmos Rewards support not yet live
